description: After the first idle the driver limits r.main to 2 live tasks, 1 live child region and 1 pending obligation (Rust set_region_limits). t.a then spawns two children (the second is refused: RegionAtCapacity), opens two child regions (the second is refused: ParentAtCapacity) and reserves two obligations (the second is refused); each refusal is ASX_E_ADMISSION_LIMIT, and joining the refused child observes it too.
